_about: 遇 — what an arrival deals when the place holds nothing of its own (design.md § 遇). The rules draw one by the day, the place and the 道号; once per place per day. Finds are authored per province ('*' serves a province with none); the road's riddles are never the story's own.

line.zh: 石缝里一株灵芝，露水未干。
line.en: A lingzhi in a cleft of the rock, the dew still on it.

line.zh: 坡上红籽一簇，拨开土，是一支老参。
line.en: A cluster of red seeds on the slope; under the soil, an old ginseng root.

line.zh: 废亭的梁上压着一刀桑皮纸，竟没受潮。
line.en: A ream of mulberry paper wedged on a beam of the ruined pavilion, somehow dry.

line.zh: 泥里半埋着一枚渡牌，绳子早烂了。
line.en: A ferry token half buried in the mud, its cord long rotted.

line.zh: 路边一只破褡裢，里头滚出几块灵石。
line.en: A torn saddlebag by the road; a few spirit stones roll out.

line.zh: 浅水里有东西一闪——是两块灵石。
line.en: Something glints in the shallows — two spirit stones.

line.zh: 草丛里一支野参，须子完好。
line.en: A wild ginseng in the grass, its roots whole.

line.zh: 树洞里塞着一卷桑皮纸，不知是谁留的。
line.en: A roll of mulberry paper tucked in a hollow tree; who left it, no one knows.

line.zh: 道旁石下压着几块灵石，像是谁的买路钱。
line.en: A few spirit stones under a roadside stone, like someone's toll.
